The top two Squiggle models (Wheelo, Holy Grail) both tip Brisbane by 8-10pts — our adjusted margin lands at 3. Footy Forecaster also tips Brisbane by 3 (notable coincidence but not used as evidence). This is a genuinely tight game with Brisbane slight favourites.

games.summary: Fremantle's fourth consecutive win on the horizon at Optus Stadium — their ODELO rating there is +23.8 (16 games, highly reliable), treating it as a second home ground. Luke Jackson (SC 122.8) dominates a West Coast side with no genuine ruck option after Samson Ryan's suspension. Wheelo rates FRE 39pts superior, all top three models agree, and FRE's contested possession advantage of 28pts per game is the most dominant stat differential in Round 6. Bolton, Serong, and Jackson form one of the best spines in the competition. West Coast's ODELO at their own home is actually negative (-6.4) — they are a genuinely different team here than their home record suggests. Derby edge to FRE.
